status: discovery only; lexical ingestion not started
title: Bangla-Koda-Mahali Dictionary
scope: 52 semantic domains; Koda and Mahali communities of Birbhum, West Bengal, with nearby Jharkhand context
licence: Copyright Visva-Bharati; no open reuse licence found in inspected front matter
selection_value: Complements existing Bangladesh survey attestations with Indian community material; not merely another copy of the SIL lists
risks: Publisher introduction explicitly states coinages were adopted where exact equivalents were unavailable; do not label all entries traditional elicited vocabulary.
Sample IPA belongs to Bangla headword; Koda/Mahali targets are Bengali script. Do not misattribute Bangla IPA to target languages.
Text layer has U+0000 substitutions and reordered Bengali characters; not safe for direct lexical import.
English glosses not present in inspected sample; avoid introducing unreviewed translations.
Images sourced separately according to introduction; lexical work must not republish illustrations.
next: Revisit Koda image-based source separately; do not confuse with Mahali or claim web inventory complete

other_lead.finding: Official page describes dictionary and grammar as work in progress; no downloadable lexical dataset identified on this page

online_inspection.method: POST with query parameters, as in publisher page JavaScript
findings: Koda and Mahali responses expose target-language ipa, Bengali-script word, record id, abs_ref concept id, grammar and semantic domain.
Koda water records4696/8106 refer to concepts1679/2095; source IPA differs (/d̪aʔ a/ versus /daʔa/). Preserve source distinctions.
Mahali water records8520/12520 refer to the same two concepts and have /d̪aʔ/.
Reverse English responses give Water in matching domains but omit record/concept IDs. Do not assume array position establishes identity.
Target transliterated field loses phonetic information; use source IPA for phonemic input, never the generic transliteration.
audio_file can be a bare directory URL with ref_audio null, not an available recording.
Deprecated DictionaryDatatable endpoint returned no data for the bounded search.
Blank search is not a complete listing endpoint.

followup_findings.lexicon_index: 13 linked domain PDFs; no pagination found in index markup
followup_findings.suggestions: water gives6 suggestions including duplicates; no IDs; empty keyword returns empty body

koda_edition.finding: XPS front matter has Unicode text; inspected lexical pages10–11 expose only page numbers as Unicode, requiring separate image/glyph extraction

mahali_edition.finding: Mahali IPA and English labels share entries. Selected over Bangla-headed PDF/API for reproducible inventory.
